supersedes: 2026-10-23.7; non-overwriting downloads, extension validation and per-input reference identities; public/private expressive rules integrated
goal: 减少上下文、临时脚本和记录往返；在局部操作前检查全局问题；保持全部视觉与来源验收。

canonical_context.validation: Verify five configuration SHA256 hashes plus master-document hash. Contract 3 binds project/revision/hashes at intake and rechecks current context at acceptance; stale jobs need new preparation and affected evidence. Completed historical records stay unchanged.
canonical_context.stale_skill: provider返回旧技能时使用已核验本地新版及现行规范；记录入口版本差异，不循环重读或声称已修复服务端缓存。
canonical_context.read_once: Reuse current rules already loaded for this task/conversation; verify bound revision/content hashes, reload changed or missing resources only. Canonical source bytes read once per bootstrap; acceptance still freshly revalidates current context. No metadata-only cross-task cache.
canonical_context.compact_bundle: PCS_Workflow_Runtime_Current.zip: controller plus verified configuration; reference photos fetched only as actually needed
canonical_context.photo_helper: 10_SYSTEM_CONFIG/scripts/photo_edit.py (preferred fused entrypoints), photo_workflow.py and style_match.py (compatible core; existing Pillow)
canonical_context.loading: 总规范和bootstrap每任务一次；专项指南只按实际任务读取，普通EDIT不预读所有修图手册。

execution.style: 每张均由专业摄影与艺术指导主动决定表达；MATCHED/PARTIAL/FALLBACK只是参考证据分支，不限制风格和强度。
execution.discovery: 选定执行路线后只发现该路线使用的参数；当前工具要求的预览必须保留。
execution.render: 协调首稿实际渲染；针对已发现问题修正；不为包装重复渲染、不合并已有非交换配方。
execution.task_resume: 已提交任务使用真实taskId续接；未知提交状态先核实，不自动重发。
execution.capture: 保留源哈希、配方或可复现指针、实际执行子集、真实输出哈希；DESIGNED与APPLIED分开。
execution.independent_work: Batch independent reads and prerequisites when known; reuse already loaded current text rather than rereading guides. Preparation follows actual source observation, submission follows actual adopted-reference observation, acceptance follows actual output review. Never fuse across these evidence boundaries.
execution.early_quality: 按所选路线确定依赖顺序；上游全局或几何输出先完成必要预览与检查，再生成依赖它的局部。RGB封顶等观测结合表达判断，因实际问题返工才重渲染。
execution.reusable_operations: photo_edit.prepare (intake/direction/candidates) -> actual reference observation -> submit (protect/select/issues/begin) -> actual external tool -> returned (finish/file check) -> actual full/detail review -> review (evidence/accept/optional snapshot). Each phase requires its actual dependencies.
execution.review_parallelism: 必要工具预览之后，独立的实际视觉检查与文件下载/数值检查可并行；验收依赖两者真实完成。源或几何变化重检受影响项。
execution.creative_scope: 按creative_direction_policy执行，不默认保守微调、全局滑块或保留原构图。
execution.reference_evidence: intent_metadata_v1 ranks observed subject/light/material/expression from index descriptions before scene/tone/color retrieval; metadata inference, not automatic vision/probability. Actual viewed scoped selection remains required
execution.photographic_finish: All routes apply photographic_naturalness_policy in style brief/actual recipe and existing real output review; no added stage, tool call or automatic visual pass.
execution.artwork_preservation: Apply protection_policy.artwork_default in the original brief/prompt and existing actual review; preserve what is visible, do not invent unclear lettering or auto-add exact per-stroke requirements.
execution.native_adjustment: Use actual non-generative tool capabilities for fidelity-critical light/color work, obtain formal output bytes, actual review and confirmed save; previews and URLs are not native-output completion. See 10_SYSTEM_CONFIG/NATIVE_ADJUSTMENT_ROUTE.md.
execution.external_adapter: Use execution_adapter_policy for all normal new calls, exact arguments, call receipt, protected regions and platform/manual separation

issue_acceptance.unit: 每项问题拆到明确目标，如clock与pier分别跟踪。
issue_acceptance.mask: 记录请求范围与实际选择范围；查看蒙版本身和边缘，bbox不是语义覆盖证明。蒙版绑定实际当前输入；几何或源输入变化后失效。
issue_acceptance.corrected: 记录最终输出哈希及该目标有效范围核验，修改后重查受影响区域。
issue_acceptance.not_needed: Observable reason and current final-output SHA256 required, no mask required. After actual review omission binds the latest reviewed output; without review provide explicit actually inspected hash. A different output invalidates the old conclusion.
issue_acceptance.accept: Contract 3 current-policy and master context, fresh source/output, actual visual/color passes and every target/reference/locked protection. Legacy contract 2 is historical; do not perform a new acceptance with it.
issue_acceptance.limitation: blocked必须以部分完成或能力限制记录并说明实质影响；不伪称完整验收。
issue_acceptance.protection: Lock protection before rendering. Ordinary artwork/inscriptions use semantic_identity with visible-source consistency; exact_content only for explicit strict or archival need. Every protected target needs actual current-output comparison evidence. Do not fail solely for source illegibility or absent per-stroke certification, and do not ignore observed edits. No acceptance-time weakening of existing contracts.
issue_acceptance.photographic_finish: visual_passed includes credible photographic texture and coherent light/geometry. Record observed artificial artifacts as targeted issues; unresolved material artifacts or uncertain affected detail cannot be a complete pass.

retrieval.implementation: urllib transport; temporary file; full Pillow decode, format/dimensions/color declaration and optional SHA256 before atomic replacement. Inspection needs existing Pillow; no implicit installation.
retrieval.failure: 失败保留既有目标文件、报告具体原因；无requests依赖和任意重试循环。
retrieval.formal_local_output: Attach the actual returned local file without copying, downloading or reuploading generated imagery merely for display/save

timing.clock: Unix timestamps for boundaries; monotonic durations for local measured operations; actual external wall boundaries explicitly labelled.
timing.tools: 调用起止、名称、结果；同时报告调用时长总和与区间并集，重叠不重复计入占用时间。
timing.comparison: 冷启动、缓存复测、增量修正分别标记；不同范围不计算提速倍数。
timing.scope: 不将本地规划、工具返回时长、云端渲染或最终保存混为整体耗时。
timing.coverage: Observed photo-save or failed/cancelled endpoint enables clipped union and unattributed gaps; overlapping stage/tool intervals not double-counted; missing stages remain null.
timing.save: Manual uses intent and actual save receipt; platform_auto uses only authoritative post-commit evidence when available. No receipt means null save endpoint, never wait/reupload or infer automatic completion
timing.record: Final archive only after confirmed persistence; pending platform snapshot explicitly pending_platform_confirmation. Historical times and absent callbacks are not invented
timing.external: stage records actually observed context/diagnosis/upload/render/download/visual/save boundaries; never label receipt-write time as visual review or API wall time as backend compute
timing.failure: finish records actual failed/cancelled endpoint and reason, no save/accept milestone. Terminal jobs are immutable; continuation uses a new task. Failed local spans live in source+start bound .timing.json sidecar to preserve rejected-operation ledger atomicity.

delivery: Follow user_facing_delivery and execution_adapter_policy; default one final photograph only, with actual scoped quality and platform/manual status separately recorded

automation.mode: Assistant-led autonomous workflow with actual professional visual review; no new user approval gate
automation.entrypoint: prepare current context is authoritative; observed old skill revision is diagnostic, never hard-code it as expected revision. entry for separate recovery only. Provider cache refresh is not claimed.
automation.render: Persist submission before call; exact task continuation; reviewed/acquired current step may next-render with archived lineage. No retry disguised as a new step.
automation.fetch: Fetch formal bytes once, hash-bound reuse, at most one bounded transfer retry; never rerender for download failure
automation.save: Unknown/failed save receipts investigated without automatic duplicate writes. Actual photo receipt → idempotent complete and compact final record → bound record intent → actual record receipt → DELIVER.
automation.review: Existing actual whole/native detail, color, issue and protection checks remain; controller never creates a visual pass
automation.history: Failed/cancelled jobs immutable; source or context drift needs new preparation. Completed historical evidence unchanged.
automation.delivery: Display, quality and persistence tracked separately. DELIVER denotes confirmed archive, not the earlier mandatory tool presentation. Platform pending snapshots are not final records

professional_direction.priority: Visual intent, hierarchy, light and material compatibility precede reference color distance; professional fallback immediately when no suitable reference
professional_direction.freedom: No fixed aesthetic, crop, technique or strength cap. Native/creative/hybrid as justified by the photograph; naturalness and source content protections retained
professional_direction.multi_step: direction before first submission; next-render only from current formally acquired, visually/profile reviewed output. Retain prior receipts; current output/input must match final acceptance
professional_direction.qa: Whole frame always; native detail of affected/protected/edge areas; expand if anomalies. No mandatory large crop/report bundle on ordinary EDIT
professional_direction.output_scope: Screen default; print proof and RAW/skin/batch reliability require actual task-specific evidence, never inferred from one example or ICC presence

expressive_finish.user_instruction: 我希望表达的明显更充分
expressive_finish.default: Atmosphere is the primary beautification objective. Choose a scene-specific emotional intent, then actively resolve composition, hierarchy, light, color and material to convey it; conservative micro-adjustment is not the default endpoint.
expressive_finish.review: Within existing actual visual review, compare source/current result and applicable task reference at delivery scale. Technical/file/content checks do not establish expressive completion. Record achieved relationships and any concrete aesthetic issue; revise unresolved expressive issues, not automatic numeric scoring Judge whether the chosen atmosphere and emotional impression are actually conveyed, not merely whether exposure was reduced. Reuse the existing direction.intent and actual review note.
expressive_finish.naturalness: Photographic credibility and expressive completion apply together. Naturalness is reviewed in the selected expression; it imposes no muted palette, low exposure, weak contrast, unchanged framing or conservative strength cap.
expressive_finish.freedom: No forced warm gold, saturation, contrast, edit amount or candidate/iteration count. Deliberate restraint may pass with actual photographic reasons
expressive_finish.reference: Explicit current user reference takes priority for suitable visual relationships, no mandatory generic reference detour and no automatic catalog import
